description: Reference backtest: BTCUSDT 1h 2024-04-01 to 2024-05-30, default strategy_config.json
note: Established after Step 3 parity gate (config-driven engine iso-functional with legacy). Survives: allocation fix, config_path fix. Fails if: PnL computation changes, matching logic changes, engine wiring changes.
rebaselined: 2026-07-28: previous values were 76 trades / net_pnl -270.797424 / sharpe -4.364, recorded 2026-06-27 in commit 0ca4666d against strategy_config.json with default_regime 'mean_reversion' (config_sha256 2754e184). They were validly measured at the time; validator rule V9, which forbids default_regime aliasing a real trading regime when rules are non-empty, was added three days later in d570ffcd (2026-06-30). From that point the shipped config raised ValueError at AdvancedStrategy construction (strategies/main_strategy.py:32) before the first bar, so these four tests errored rather than ran. Setting default_regime to 'unknown' — the only value that both passes V9 and makes an unmatched bar genuinely flat — routes 586 bars from mean_reversion (794) to unknown (208 remain), and those bars produce avg_forecast 0.0, so 76 trades -> 24. CONTROL, run 2026-07-28 to prove this delta is the config and not an engine regression: replaying the old config with only the V9 check suppressed still yields 76 trades / -270.797404 / sharpe -4.364 at config_sha256 2754e184. Note net_pnl differs from the recorded value by 2.0e-5 (-270.797404 vs -270.797424) — inside this fixture's own 0.01 tolerance, but a real drift; cause not identified, presumed float accumulation order. Values below are measured from run 20260728T132811Z_5ccbec42 (config_sha256 5ccbec42, data_sha256 5a75366c).
